name: Guangdong Lyric Robot Automation Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Lyric Robot Automation Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of intelligent equipment in China and Internationally. It provides EV prismatic, cylindrical Li, and EV pouch battery cells; and coating machines, laser notching and slitting machines, laser cutting and stacking machines, winding machines, long prismatic and power soft pack battery cell assembly lines, forming and capacity grading machines, module and pack lines, and x-ray inspection machines; power soft pack battery cell assembly line; aluminum shell injection machines, blade battery infusion, and ultrasonic pre- and final welding machines.
